He is a 2.01 m (6 ft 7 in) tall [[shooting guard]]-[[small forward]].[http://cobrasports.gr/index.php/2011-12-12-03-36-00/2011-12-13-12-34-52/1836-2012-06-27-15-54-04 CobraSports.gr ΘΑΝΑΣΗΣ ΑΝΤΕΤΟΚΟΥΜΠΟ Με ενδιαφέρει ο Ολυμπιακός, αλλά...{{el icon}}.] ==Professional career== Antetokounmpo began his pro career with the [[HEBA A2|Greek Second Division]] club [[Filathlitikos BC|Filathlitikos]] in 2012. During the 2012–13 season with Filathlitikos, he averaged 12.2 points, 4.9 rebounds, 1.0 assists, 1.1 steals and 1.0 blocks per game in the Greek 2nd Division.[http://basketball.usbasket.com/player/USA/Delaware_87ers/Thanasis_Antetokounmpo/199778?Cntry=&PlayerID=199778&stats=2013 Basketball.USBasket.com Thanasis Antetokounmpo Statistics Season: 2012-2013 (Greece)] He was selected by the coaches to play in the 2013 [[HEBA Greek All Star Game|Greek All Star Game]] as a special participant, after competing at the slam dunk contest, as players from the 2nd division are eligible to compete in the dunk competition. After originally declaring for the [[2013 NBA draft]], he withdrew from the draft on June 17, 2013, along with 17 other players, on the day of the withdrawal deadline.[http://www.nba.com/2013/news/06/18/2013-draft-withdrawals/ Eighteen early-entry candidates withdraw from 2013 Draft] He had originally entered the draft with his younger brother [[Giannis Antetokounmpo|Giannis]]. On November 1, 2013, he was selected by the [[NBA D-League]]'s [[Delaware 87ers]], with the 9th pick in the [[2013 NBA Development League Draft]].[http://www.nba.com/dleague/draft2013/ 2013 NBA Development League Draft] On November 23, 2013, in his D-League debut, Antetokounmpo recorded 14 points, 2 rebounds, and 2 assists, in a 117-106 loss to the [[Canton Charge]].[http://www.nba.com/dleague/games/20131123/DELCTN/gameinfo.html NBA Development League: 87ers at Charge Game Info] He also competed at the 2014 [[NBA Development League All-Star Game#Slam Dunk Contest|NBA D-League Slam Dunk Contest]]. During the [[2013–14 NBA Development League season]], he averaged 12.0 points, 4.3 rebounds, 2.1 assists, 1.2 steals and 1.3 blocks per game.[http://www.basketball-reference.com/nbdl/players/a/antetth01d.html Thanasis Antetokounmpo D-League Stats] On May 1, 2014, he was selected to the 2014 NBA D-League All-Defensive Third Team.[http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/nba_development_league_all_nba_dleague_teams_2014_05_01.html NBA Development League Announces 2013-14 All-NBA D-League Selections] ==Personal== Antetokounmpo was born in [[Athens]], [[Greece]], to parents of [[Nigeria]]n descent.[http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/news/colu/p/newsid/55082/arti.html FIBA.com Adetokoubo's whirlwind saga just starting.] Although he is of Nigerian descent, he does not have Nigerian citizenship.[http://www.sport24.gr/Basket/ElladaBasket/ginontai_ellhnes_oi_antetokoumpo.2212687.html Γίνονται Έλληνες οι Αντετοκούμπο {{el icon}}.] He and his family officially gained full Greek citizenship on May 9, 2013,[http://www.sport24.gr/Basket/ellhnes_polites_oi_aderfoi_antetokoumpo.2244998.html Sport24.gr Έλληνες πολίτες οι αδερφοί Αντετοκούμπο {{el icon}}.] with the official legal spelling of his name being Antetokounmpo.[https://twitter.com/DimitropulosFCM/status/332489901717196801 Antetokounmpo received today his Greek citizenship. As of today, this shall be the official name/surname as it appears in ID/Passport.] His younger brother, [[Giannis Antetokounmpo|Giannis]], is also a professional basketball player that was drafted 15th overall in the [[2013 NBA draft]], by the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].[http://nbadraft.net/players/giannis-adetokoubo NBADraft.net Giannis Adetokoubo.] He is known by the nickname of "Greek Freak 2".[http://dimemag.com/2014/02/meet-thanasis-antetokounmpo-greek-freak-part-2/ Meet Thanasis Antetokounmpo: The Greek Freak, Part 2][https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qg6Iq3rfnpw Thanasis Antetokounmpo "Greek Freak 2" 2012-13 Greek Season Mix] ==Awards and accomplishments== *[[HEBA Greek All Star Game|Greek League All-Star Game]] (special participant): (2013) *[[NBA D-League]] All-Defensive Third Team: (2014) ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://twitter.com/Adeto_kouboS Twitter Account] *[http://stats.nbadleague.com/playerProfile.html?PlayerID=203648 NBA D-League Profile] *[http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Thanasis_Antetokounmpo/199778 Eurobasket.com Profile] *[http://nbadraft.net/players/thanasis-antetokounmpo NBADraft.net Profile] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Thanasis-Antetokounmpo-71005/ Draftexpress.com Profile] {{Persondata | NAME = Antetokounmpo, Athanasios "Thanasis" | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = Adetokunbo, Thanasis | SHORT DESCRIPTION = Greek basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = July 17, 1992 | PLACE OF BIRTH = Athens, Greece | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Antetokounmpo, Thanasis}} [[Category:1992 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Delaware 87ers players]] [[Category:Filathlitikos B.C. players]] [[Category:Greek basketball players]] [[Category:Greek expatriate basketball people in the United States]] [[Category:Greek people of Nigerian descent]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Small forwards]]
